description: Cuts the subject (people, products, animals, objects) out of a JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or JPEG XL photo with the ormbg AI model, on this machine. Writes a transparent PNG, WebP or AVIF, or the subject on a new colour; can crop to the subject. The first call installs Transformers.js with ONNX Runtime (about 450 MB) and downloads the model (45 MB) into the cache.

format.description: Default png; jpeg needs a background

name: image_remove_background
title: Remove the background of a photo
